meta.parties: Mrs. Noor Mohideen Et Al v. Hadood Sadoon Et Al

rules.statement: Property held by a fiduciary under a fidei commissum passes to the fiduciary's descendants as a joint fidei commissum, not separate fidei commissa.
rules.supporting_quote: "In my opinion the property that Safia Umma held as a fiduciary passed on her death to her children as a joint fidei commissum and not as separate fidei commissa."
